metadata.name: bide
metadata.description: Bide: name your price, get paid until it fills (cash-secured puts / covered calls on Solana)

accounts.name: caller
docs: owner for close_plan; anyone for expire_plan

accounts.name: vault_collateral
docs: ATA(phase collateral mint, lend_auth): Lend withdrawals land here first

accounts.name: vault_f_token
docs: ATA(fToken, lend_auth); None when the collateral has no Lend market

accounts.name: vault_asset
docs: Wheel-Accumulate only: ATA(asset, lend_auth) holding filled asset

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: USDC for Buy/Wheel, asset mint for Sell

accounts.name: vault_f_token
docs: ATA(fToken of collateral_mint, lend_auth); None if the collateral has no Lend market

accounts.name: caller
docs: owner for close_plan; anyone for expire_plan

accounts.name: vault_collateral
docs: ATA(phase collateral mint, lend_auth): Lend withdrawals land here first

accounts.name: vault_f_token
docs: ATA(fToken, lend_auth); None when the collateral has no Lend market

accounts.name: vault_asset
docs: Wheel-Accumulate only: ATA(asset, lend_auth) holding filled asset

accounts.name: escrow_mint
docs: asset mint for a Put, USDC for a Call

accounts.name: mint
docs: USDC or WSOL

accounts.name: sol_asset
docs: SOL asset (spot feed params)

accounts.name: user_dest
docs: Call: owner's USDC account. Validated.

accounts.name: vault_staging
docs: ATA(USDC (Put) | asset (Call), lend_auth)

errors.name: OutsideAuctionWindow
errors.msg: Outside the auction window for this epoch kind

errors.name: StrikeOffTick
errors.msg: Strike is not on the asset tick

errors.name: SizeTooLarge
errors.msg: Size exceeds the plan's remaining size

errors.name: PremiumBelowUserMin
errors.msg: Premium below the user's signed minimum (after fee)

errors.name: ActiveRoundExists
errors.msg: Plan already has an active round

errors.name: SpotMovedTooMuch
errors.msg: Spot moved too much since the auction opened

errors.name: SampleOutsideBucket
errors.msg: Sample publish time outside the bucket

errors.name: SettlementPending
errors.msg: A settlement is pending on this plan

errors.name: EpochKindMismatch
errors.msg: Epoch kind does not match the plan

errors.name: NotImplemented
errors.msg: Not implemented yet (ships in a program upgrade)

errors.name: RoundTooSmall
errors.msg: Round notional below the minimum (1 USDC)

fields.name: spot_feed
docs: Pyth sponsored push-feed account (PriceUpdateV2 owned by the receiver) used for auction spot

fields.name: lend_f_token_mint
docs: Jupiter Lend fToken mint for this asset's market (Pubkey::default() = no Lend, plain vault e.g. tBTC)

fields.name: bucket_tolerance_secs
docs: u32 (BUILD says u8) so a Plan-B tolerance of a whole 300 s bucket fits

fields.name: collateral_principal
docs: USDC (Buy / Wheel-Accumulate) or asset units (Sell / Wheel-Exit) principal deposited

fields.name: lend_shares
docs: fTokens held by the plan's lend_auth vault for the current phase's market

fields.name: reserved_usdc
docs: USDC held outside the vaults: escrow of live pool Calls (= call_open_notional) + receivables of exercised
pool Puts awaiting withdraw_collateral.

fields.name: reserved_wsol
docs: WSOL held outside the vaults: escrow of live pool Puts (= put_open_size) + receivables of exercised pool Calls
awaiting withdraw_collateral.

fields.name: put_open_size
docs: Σ size (WSOL) escrowed by live pool Puts (subset of reserved_wsol).

fields.name: put_open_notional
docs: Σ strike notional (USDC) of live pool Puts: what the pool receives if they are exercised.

fields.name: call_open_notional
docs: Σ notional (USDC) escrowed by live pool Calls (subset of reserved_usdc).

fields.name: call_open_size
docs: Σ size (WSOL) of live pool Calls: what the pool receives if they are exercised.
